controller_structural_checks.classification: provided controller checks, not your fresh proof; do not rerun admin suites

scope: Judge comprehensive nature, coherence and buildability of this implementation directive across F1–F8. Targeted source questions allowed; no whole-framework source audit. Prior Docling evaluation established. New candidate integration tests and model/counter evidence remain planned acceptance/gates, not work to execute now.
explicit_exclusions: No Docling/OCR/model behavior tests, dependency installation, imports/tests/builds, network/provider/store access.
No full AST/test/fixture inventory rebuild, evidence-archive/member hashing, wheel inspection or old harness replay.
Finance tests/test_integration_massive.py entirely excluded from reading, parsing and execution. No credential handling.
No user YAML contents, .friday* contents, exports, .venv contents, secrets or production state. Metadata/hash-only checks of the declared preserved entries are permitted.

No prior/peer council reports, transcripts, memory/history lookup or controller private reasoning. Current permitted documents may contain historical provenance labels; these labels are context, not evidence or automatic disqualification.
No repository or supplied-input writes, delegation, repairs, replacement or another round by this seat.
procedure: First hash this request and verify its supplied digest before reading; verify target/input identities.
Read-only fresh context; scratch only a new physical external reviewer-owned directory outside repo and supplied-input directory.
At entry and exit, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git ls-files -s -z before status; compare HEAD/branch/index/status/staging and declared dirty/protected metadata. Do not hash every repository file.
Read the target/brief and required context. Assess all eight areas; use bounded direct source reads only for material interface/consumer questions. Recover normal output truncation.
Do the design assessment before report drafting. No admin/test/inventory/archive checklist is assigned to this seat.

Return durable compact F1–F8 report and completion flag, honest coverage/overall scores ONLY when assessment complete, mandatory findings with exact section/gap/bounded fix and acceptance implication, separate advisories/limits, source reads and boundary checks.
If truly unable to finish, report INCOMPLETE/BLOCKED with precise cause and overall=null. Do not invent a design quality score for unread work.
Stop after this seat. Controller owns permitted bounded correction/fresh rounds, never this reviewer. A VERIFIED document result grants no construction/effects/UAT/acceptance/delivery.

scoring.coverage_meaning: Completeness of the eight-area focused directive assessment, not every source method or runtime behavior.
scoring.honesty: Never inflate, average or round up. Preserve actual limitations.

report_length_guideline: 1000–2000 words usually enough, with concise F1–F8 table; more if findings require. No repeated source catalogs.
